title: Weak limits of integer multiplicity currents with locally liminf-bounded masses are integer multiplicity
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ. Notation: for P, n ∈ ℕ, an open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(T) ∈ [0, ∞] is the local mass, the supremum of T(ω) over test forms ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and Euclidean covector norm |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for every x; for T ∈ 𝒟_d(U), boundaryMassOn(T, W) := M_W(∂T) if d ≥ 1 and := 0 if d = 0; for an open V ⊆ U, T|_V ∈ 𝒟_n(V) is the domain restriction (T|_V(ω) = T(ω) for ω ∈ 𝒟^n(V) ⊆ 𝒟^n(U)); T_j ⇀ T means T_j(ω) → T(ω) for every test form ω of the common domain; B_k(0) is the open ball of radius k ∈ ℕ about 0. Assume CL(d): for all P, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, all integer multiplicity T_j ∈ 𝒟_d(U) (j ∈ ℕ) with sup_j (M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure contained in U, and T_j ⇀ T ∈ 𝒟_d(U), the current T is integer multiplicity. Assume IML(d), the degree-d case of the conclusion of the parent's sibling theorem dmcbr_isIntegerMultiplicity_of_local (which the parent discharges with that theorem): for all P, open U ⊆ ℝ^P and X ∈ 𝒟_d(U), (1) if M_W(X) < ∞ for every open W with compact closure contained in U, and every x ∈ U has some r > 0 with B_r(x) ⊆ U and X|_{B_r(x)} integer multiplicity, then X is integer multiplicity; (2) if V ⊆ U is open and X is integer multiplicity, then X|_V is integer multiplicity. Let P ∈ ℕ and Z_i, Z ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ) such that every Z_i is integer multiplicity, Z_i ⇀ Z, and liminf_{i→∞} (M_{B_k(0)}(Z_i) + boundaryMassOn(Z_i, B_k(0))) < ∞ for every k ∈ ℕ. Then Z is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ d : ℕ, (∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → X.massOn W < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ h : ball x r ⊆ U, IsIntegerMultiplicity (X.restrictDomain h)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X) ∧ (∀ (V : Set (Euclid P)) (h : V ⊆ U), IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (X.restrictDomain h))) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (Zs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ i, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Zs i)) → WeaklyConvergesOn Zs Z → (∀ k : ℕ, liminf (fun i => (Zs i).massOn (ball (0 : Euclid P) k) + boundaryMassOn (Zs i) (ball (0 : Euclid P) k)) atTop < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z
